lines.text: The fool says in his heart that there is no God, and his acts are vile.
The LORD looks down from Sinai to see who seeks God, but all have turned away.
The workers of iniquity devour God's people like bread and refuse to call upon the LORD.
The sinners are overwhelmed with dread because God is with the righteous, and the LORD is the shelter of the oppressed.
David longs for the salvation of Israel to come from Bethel, so that Jacob will rejoice.
